title: Card-Volume Reduction on Paloma Business Card Deposits
content:
The card deposit rate of a Paloma Business debit-card deposit carries a card-volume reduction, in percentage points, decided by the total of all debit-card deposits received in the three months before the day the fee is worked out, counted from the day after the same calendar day three months earlier up to and including that day.

### Reduction clause

A total of 20000.00 USD or more earns a card-volume reduction of 0.30 percentage points; a total of 10000.00 USD up to 19999.99 USD earns 0.15 percentage points; a smaller total earns none. The reduction is taken off the card deposit rate in percentage points.

### Questions answered

**Which deposits are added up?** Every debit-card deposit received in the window, including the most recent one when it falls inside the window. ACH credit and wire deposits are not part of the total.

**A fee worked out on 14 August: which days count?** 15 May through 14 August.

**Debit-card deposits of 12000.00 USD and 8000.00 USD in the window.** 20000.00 USD: 0.30 percentage points.

**A single debit-card deposit of 9999.99 USD in the window.** Below 10000.00 USD: no card-volume reduction.

**Debit-card deposits totalling 19999.99 USD.** 0.15 percentage points.

**What does a reduction of 0.30 percentage points do to a rate of 2.20 percent?** The rate becomes 1.90 percent.
